order_note: Any time after SQL 91 (aws/workflows/sql/91_moov_onboarding.sql, applied to production 2026-10-19), and before Moov onboarding is used in production: SQL 91 added the onboarding policies on public.payment_provider_accounts, public.payment_provider_methods, public.payment_method_verifications and public.payment_event_log but granted checksops nothing on them (their only grants are supabase's, to authenticated and service_role), so checksops gets "permission denied for table payment_provider_accounts" before the policies are evaluated (staging 2026-10-20 12:18:20Z, moov-onboarding-save, right after Moov accepted the account; SQL 104 fixed the same gap for payment_idempotency_keys). SQL 105 grants SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE on the first three tables and SELECT and INSERT on payment_event_log to checksops and authenticated and changes nothing else; SQL 91's file, pins and fingerprint (f8611dcc...) are unchanged. No later migration revokes these grants, so it is not re-run. Staging has not been granted by hand: its read-live is expected to show the checksops lines absent and a guarded staging apply is needed before production (ops/production-sql-105-apply.md).

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 105: sql105-onboarding-payment-table-grants-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql105-onboarding-payment-table-grants); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql105. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): the SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE grants of checksops and authenticated on public.payment_provider_accounts, public.payment_provider_methods and public.payment_method_verifications, and their SELECT and INSERT grants on public.payment_event_log (spec table_privileges). The post-conditions also require every other grant on each of the four tables unchanged (other_table_privileges_unchanged) and the rest of the catalog unchanged. The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.
